description: This source file defines a PHP class `perf_oci8` that extends `adodb_perf` to implement performance monitoring and tuning tools for Oracle databases using OCI8. It includes methods for generating reports on database performance metrics, checking memory and cache usage, analyzing SQL query performance, and providing recommendations.

classes.name: perf_oci8
classes.description: A class for Oracle database performance monitoring and analysis, extending the `adodb_perf` class. It provides methods to generate various performance reports, cache advice, SQL analysis, and database configuration checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the performance object, sets database connection, and retrieves server info.

methods.name: LogMode
methods.description: Returns instructions on how to turn Oracle database logging mode on or off.

methods.name: TopRecentWaits
methods.description: Fetches and displays the top 5 recent wait events from the system event view.

methods.name: TopHistoricalWaits
methods.description: Fetches and displays the top 10 historical wait events over a specified period from Active Session History.

methods.name: TableSpace
methods.description: Provides details on tablespaces and data files including size and usage.

methods.name: RMAN
methods.description: Retrieves recent RMAN backup status information.

methods.name: DynMemoryUsage
methods.description: Shows dynamic memory component sizes, adapting to Oracle version.

methods.name: FlashUsage
methods.description: Shows usage statistics for Flash Recovery Area.

methods.name: WarnPageCost
methods.description: Provides a warning about the current optimizer page cost setting.

methods.name: WarnIndexCost
methods.description: Provides a warning about the current index cost setting.

methods.name: PGA
methods.description: Placeholder for PGA related info (not implemented).

methods.name: PGA_Advice
methods.description: Provides an estimate and recommendations for PGA size.

methods.name: Explain
methods.description: Generates an execution plan explanation for a given SQL statement.

methods.name: CheckMemory
methods.description: Checks and reports on database cache and memory advice, including cache sizing recommendations.

methods.name: tohtml
methods.description: Converts a recordset into an HTML table for display.

methods.name: SuspiciousSQL
methods.description: Analyzes and reports suspicious or expensive SQL statements based on buffer gets or disk reads.

methods.name: ExpensiveSQL
methods.description: Analyzes and reports SQL statements with high disk reads.

methods.name: clearsql
methods.description: Clears the performance log table by deleting entries older than the current date.
